name: arcade_cabinet_topdown
facing: its screen and controls face the viewer
description: a retro upright arcade cabinet: a deep navy body with sunset-stripe side art, a glowing screen showing an original pixel scene - a little rocket over rolling green hills under stars, no characters from any real game on the front of the upper part, a joystick and six round buttons on the control panel, a softly lit blank marquee on top (no words, no logos)
